Confido | Forward Deployed Engineer | $200-270k BASE | ON-SITE (NYC, Chelsea) | Full-time

We manage over $3B for CPG brands like OLIPOP, Tropicana, and Dr. Squatch. We 5x'ed revenue last year and are on track to 4x this year.

The role is engineering + customer implementation: working closely with customers that are household names to run their implementations to ground, as well as enable the broader set of customers.

Stack is Rails, Python, TypeScript, Postgres, and AWS.
